template.name: Nova
template.entry_long: close > open and roc(close,{p0}) > {p0} and roc(close,{p1}) > roc(close,{p2})
template.notes: The Level1 ask-versus-stored-ask test is approximated on bars as a bullish candle that has gained more than 1% and is accelerating, with the reverse as exit. StepPips 1% is an explicit fallback; the seconds-based snapshot, StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips and LossCoefficient sizing are not expressible.
